entries.title: Psalms 80:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Testimony Concerning the Lilies. A Psalm of Asaph. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, You who lead Joseph like a flock; You dwelling between the cherubs, shine forth.

entries.title: Psalms 80:2
segments: Stir up Your strength before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, and come, save us.

entries.title: Psalms 80:3
segments: Turn us again, O God, and cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved!

entries.title: Psalms 80:4
segments: O LORD God of hosts, how long will You be angry against the prayer of Your people?

entries.title: Psalms 80:5
segments: You feed them with the bread of tears; and give them tears to drink in great measure.

entries.title: Psalms 80:6
segments: You make us a strife for our neighbors; and our enemies laugh among themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 80:7
segments: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause Your face to shine; and we shall be saved.

entries.title: Psalms 80:8
segments: You have brought a vine out of Egypt; You have cast out the nations and planted it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:9
segments: You cleared before it, and caused it to take deep root; and it filled the land.

entries.title: Psalms 80:10
segments: The hills were covered [with] its shadow, and its boughs [were as] the great cedars.

entries.title: Psalms 80:11
segments: It sent out its boughs to the sea, and its branches to the river.

entries.title: Psalms 80:12
segments: Why have You broken down its hedges, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

entries.title: Psalms 80:13
segments: The boar out of the wood wastes it, and the wild beast of the field eats it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:14
segments: Return, we beg You, O God of hosts; look down from Heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,

entries.title: Psalms 80:15
segments: and the vineyard which Your right hand has planted, and the Son [that] You make strong for Yourself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:16
segments: [It is] burned with fire, and cut down; they perish at the rebuke of Your holy face.

entries.title: Psalms 80:17
segments: Let Your hand be on the Man of Your right hand, on the Son of man [whom] You have made strong for Yourself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:18
segments: So we will not go back from You; make us live, and we will call on Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 80:19
segments: Turn us again, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved.
